description: ADD TO YOUR PRIVATE SECURITY REPORT — more reproduction detail, a correction, or the answer to an operator's question. Takes the `ps_…` receipt and one `message` (up to 4,000 characters). The message is added to the thread; the report's title and body are NEVER echoed back to you, and this call does not repeat your message in its answer. Receipt-scoped to the account that filed it: a wrong receipt and somebody else's receipt are the same `not found`. CAP: 20 messages from the reporter per report. Nothing here reopens, closes or re-prioritises anything; a person reads it.

message.description: what you want the operators to know — up to 4,000 characters

receipt.description: the `ps_…` receipt report_security returned with the report

name: security_reply
title: Reply to a security report
